description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The client is a biotechnology company, and Raydar is recruiting a Software Engineer on its behalf. The role involves building full-stack features, automating laboratory and analysis processes, and applying machine learning and data processing techniques to complex scientific datasets while working closely with scientists and clients.
Full-stack scientific software engineer building data visualization, machine-learning analysis, and laboratory automation tools

Responsibilities:
• Build full-stack features, including client-facing web dashboards, status notifications and improvements to data visualization pipelines
• Apply machine learning techniques to automatically detect boundaries within complex scientific data
• Automate repetitive laboratory and analysis processes end to end
• Deliver timely, dependable code for high-stakes projects with external customers
• Talk directly with scientists and clients to shape product direction with a customer-focused mindset

Requirements:
• A history of releasing software that real users depend on, at an organization that prizes quality
• Strong internships or past roles at companies recognized for engineering excellence
• Proficiency in Python for data processing and production code
• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, GCP or Azure
• A resume that demonstrates measurable impact, with accomplishments expressed as before-and-after results rather than tool lists
• No minimum years of experience required

Preferred:
• Past work creating dashboards or visual analytics for external users
• Experience handling large-scale scientific or otherwise complex datasets
• Familiarity with modern front-end development using a popular JavaScript framework and a typed superset of the language
